directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay. Suppose you have two options upon graduation: one is to go to a graduate school. You are to make a choice between the two. Write an essay to explain the reasons for your choice. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Upon graduation, many students face a crucial decision: whether to go to a graduate school or start working. After careful consideration, I have decided to pursue further studies at a graduate school.

To begin with, a graduate school provides a more in-depth and specialized learning environment. For example, in my major of computer science, a master's program can offer advanced courses and research opportunities that are not available at the undergraduate level. This will enhance my professional skills and knowledge, making me more competitive in the future job market.

In addition, the network I can build in graduate school is invaluable. I will have the chance to interact with professors who are experts in their fields and classmates with diverse backgrounds. These connections may open doors to various career opportunities and collaborations.

In conclusion, going to a graduate school is a better option for me as it can help me gain more knowledge, skills, and valuable connections, which will lay a solid foundation for my future career.
